```python
from fastmcp.server import FastMCP
from fastmcp.prompts import Message

server = FastMCP("summarize-server")


@server.prompt(name="summarize")
def summarize_prompt(text: str) -> list:
    """Message template that asks the model to summarize text."""
    return [Message(f"Please summarize the following text:\n\n{text}")]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    server.run()
```
